name: Perplexity
short: Search-native API platform: Orchestrator API (private preview) serving Perplexity-hosted open models (Kimi K3, GLM 5.3, DeepSeek V4 Pro), an Agent API with third-party frontier models and paid tools, Search API billed per request, and Embeddings/Decisions APIs; Perplexity Pro $20/mo.

plans.name: API Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Orchestrator API (private preview) bills per token at model rates - Perplexity-hosted: kimi-k3 $3.00/$15.00, glm-5.3 $1.40/$4.40, glm-5.3-flash $0.15/$0.50, deepseek-v4-pro-0813 $1.32/$3.96 per 1M, with discounted cache reads. Agent API adds third-party models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, Z.AI, Moonshot AI, NVIDIA) plus tool fees (web_search $0.0025/invocation, fetch_url $0.0005, sandbox $0.03/session). Search API $5.00 per 1K requests ($1.00 with Fast Search); Decisions API $0.01-$0.02 per 1M input tokens (output free); Embeddings $0.004-$0.05 per 1M.

plans.name: Perplexity Pro
plans.notes: Unlimited Pro searches, reasoning models, and file analysis in web and mobile apps.
